title: alstonia muelleriana
intro: Alstonia muelleriana, commonly known as the Queensland Toonbal, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Alstonia muelleriana include its antimalarial, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids such as muelleroxin and alstonine, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
